equipment_name: Fire extinguisher, Emergency light, Exit signs, Emergency radio
audit_item:
Fire extinguisher
- Verifying visible and accessible
- Pressure gauge is in green zone
- Confirming the pin and tamper seal are in place
- Looking for any signs of damage or obstruction on the nozzle and hose
Exit signs
- 30second functional test
- Check for physical damage
- 90minute battery test (annually) 
Emergency lighting
- 30second functional test
- Conduct a visual inspection of the unit for any physical damage
- 90minute duration on battery.
